name: 43447-sharedcontext-gemma312b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), node to itself
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier, no draft model
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 160 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, static seed 43447
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, single population, temperature 0 -- one fixed 32768-token prefix carried by every request plus a 2048-token body unique to each, and exactly 1024 tokens generated
purpose: A 12-billion-parameter document analysis assistant answering four concurrent questions against one shared 32k-token manual on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM source checkout 22c2e87555a23db6fd8860fff3ef7178dd24aec2 (v0.22.1rc0-163-g22c2e87555a2),
# not a release. Keys from a later vLLM will not be accepted by this era's AsyncEngineArgs.
model: unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: true

# Forced from below by the declared load: 32768 + 2048 prompt + 1024 output = 35840 tokens.
max-model-len: 40960

# Everything else -- gpu-memory-utilization, block-size, dtype, enforce-eager, max-num-seqs,
# max-num-batched-tokens -- is deliberately left at the engine's own default.
